objective: Run the new proven Libertas0 SYNC module through a real local-browser/music soak after the hosted soak passed. Validate only the real-browser/audio-path residue; do not patch product code from the report branch.
scope: 10-minute continuous SYNC hold with ordinary music
one loop while SYNC is active
no hidden corrective seeks or new frame discontinuities
steps: Fetch refs and check out exact SHA 93d6c5b83549e598cc8718e830cb7effbf35eb0d.
Run python bootstrap.py and require LIBERTAS BOOT: PASS.
Run npm install && npm run check.
Open the simple Libertas0 Test Console in the normal headed local browser and physical audio output; Fullscreen may be used.
Load two ordinary constant-tempo music tracks. Prefer material already used in prior Libertas0 physical gates. If different source files are used, upload them to the task Drive folder.
Use Track Intelligence/manual grid only as needed to establish correct grids. Record the actual applied BPM/grid identities.
Start both decks and enable SYNC with Deck A as leader. Hold continuously for at least 10 minutes.
During the hold, change Deck A rate several times within approximately 0.95x to 1.05x, execute at least two explicit follower jog or hotcue actions, and exercise one loop.
Reverse leadership once and allow normal convergence.
Record the full test mix from the post-master recording path for at least the 10-minute SYNC interval when practical.

Capture telemetry before/after and at representative intervals: syncTracking, syncLocked, syncPhaseErrorBeats, transportSeekCount, frameDiscontinuities, performanceJumpCount, sourceFrame, playbackRate.
Upload the saved recording and runtime JSON to Drive folder Libertas0/Step 12/SYNC-SOAK-V3-001.
On validation/local-debug modify only reports/local-debug/** and push the report branch.
evidence_required: source track filenames and hashes or Drive references
phase-error samples and final phase error
hidden transport seek delta for both decks
frame discontinuity deltas for both decks
Drive file IDs or URLs for recording/runtime evidence and any new source files
audible assessment if the local testing setup can genuinely assess it; otherwise NOT_EVALUATED rather than invented
stop_conditions: Any hidden SYNC maintenance seek occurs.
Any new A/B frame discontinuity attributable to SYNC occurs.
SYNC repeatedly fails to re-lock after explicit follower performance actions.
The test cannot produce or persist the required runtime evidence.
